region_dim.description: Dimension of the interval input that holds the regions.

field_dim.description: Dimension of the interval input that holds the fields.

chrom_field.description: Column holding the source chromosome name.

end_field.description: Column holding the exclusive interval end.

strand_field.description: Optional strand column; empty disables skipping of unmapped rows.

output.description: Output port name; defaults to the operator name.
